what: Two server pause points in the editor's mint path (commitDraft) and one client gate in the live join, each asking the stack's gate service whether to go on: for deterministic interleavings of concurrent commits (C8, C9b; S4, S4b; I6) and simultaneous first joins (C4; S1)

gates.name: mint-before-id
gates.where: functions/src/lib/draft.ts commitDraft: after the dedup query and before the version id is chosen (max(N)+1)

gates.name: mint-after-upload
gates.where: functions/src/lib/draft.ts commitDraft: between the upload of v(N+1)/ and the transaction that makes it current

gates.name: join-before-bind
gates.where: app/src/viewer/useSharedDocument.ts: after log.ready() has delivered the existing live log, before bindSync binds (and maybe seeds) the host
